subject: Partial-invoice flow and commitment credit handling for Horizon Labs
messages:
From: Dana Morgan <dana.morgan@horizonlabs.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@horizonlabs.com
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood commercial - PO and invoicing constraints

Hi Priyom / Vanessa,

Thanks for the proposal. Procurement reviewed the commercial terms and we have a few constraints we need to confirm before we can issue a PO: 

- Our ERP requires a single quarterly PO per vendor for this engagement (one PO per calendar quarter).
- Net60 standard payment terms (we can consider Net45 with early-invoice approvals).
- We need invoices to map 1:1 to the PO number and to be submitted monthly (not weekly).
- If you plan to apply any commitment credits or one-time onboarding credits, those must be referenced as a discrete line item on the invoice and described in the PO.
- Any negative-line credits require our procurement signature and the vendor’s tax details on the PO.

I've attached our PO template (Horizon_PO_Template.pdf) and our legal team asks that any alternative invoicing cadence be explicitly accepted in email before we sign.

Can Redwood support: a monthly invoice schedule that applies a commitment-triggered credit (applied as a negative line) while still using our single-quarter PO approach? Also confirm how Redwood will surface the credit ID on invoices.

Thanks,
Dana Morgan
Sr. Procurement Manager
Horizon Labs

Attachment: Horizon_PO_Template.pdf (application/pdf)

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: Dana Morgan <dana.morgan@horizonlabs.com>
Cc: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood commercial - PO and invoicing constraints

Dana — thanks for the clear summary and the template. Short answers up front: yes, we can support the monthly invoice schedule against a single quarterly PO and we can present commitment credits as a discrete negative line item referencing an agreed credit ID.

A couple of operational details to make sure we match your ERP: 
- Invoices: Redwood will submit one invoice per calendar month. Each invoice will include the Horizon PO number and a "Commitment Credit" line when applicable.
- Credit presentation: We will print "Commitment Credit: CC-78391" as the line item description and include Redwood's internal credit reference for audit.
- Tax and vendor info: attaching our Redwood vendor tax summary and a short credit-terms spreadsheet for your review (Redwood_Credit_Terms.xlsx).

If Horizon needs an exception to Net60 (e.g., Net45) in exchange for a small prepayment discount, we can outline that as an option in the amended SOW. Otherwise we will honor Net60.

Next steps I propose: 
1) If the approach above looks acceptable, supply a draft PO using your template with the PO number populated and the credit line referenced.
2) We will return an amended SOW to include the credit mechanics and invoice mapping language for signature.

Happy to jump on a short call if you prefer.

Best,
Priyom Das
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_Credit_Terms.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: priyom.das@redwood.ai <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 11:06:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Redwood commercial - PO and invoicing constraints

Forwarding Dana's note — procurement is explicit about one PO per quarter and they need the credit to be a discrete line item.

Key asks for pricing: does the team want to (a) apply the commitment credit across the first invoice only, (b) pro-rate the credit across the first two months, or (c) show it as a single negative line distributed in month 1 and 2? Procurement prefers a single credit line in month 1 but they've asked for the PO to call it out.

Also want to confirm: if we offer Net45 in exchange for a 1% prepayment discount (applied to gross invoice before credit), is that a tolerable commercial to push for faster cash?

Thoughts — can you propose the recommended approach and an approval to send to Dana?

----- Forwarded message -----
From: Dana Morgan <dana.morgan@horizonlabs.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Redwood commercial - PO and invoicing constraints
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai

(see above)

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, ben.carter@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 26 Aug 2027 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Redwood commercial - PO and invoicing constraints

Thanks — quick internal recommendation: 

1) Credit mechanics: present the commitment credit as a single negative line item on the first monthly invoice (month-of-activation). Use label: "Commitment Credit: CC-78391" with Redwood internal ref in the invoice notes. This matches procurement preference and is easiest for audit.

2) Credit amount handling: if the credit is material (>10% of quarter), split the credit across month 1 & month 2 to avoid large negative netting in month 1 that can confuse revenue recognition — propose split only if accounting flags it. Otherwise single-line month 1 is fine. We'll confirm with finance if needed.

3) Net terms incentive: offer Net45 with 1% prepayment discount if Horizon will commit to annualized minimums (this is our lever). For an already-committed quarterly PO this is borderline — propose we table Net45 unless procurement explicitly requests.

4) SOW amendment: I'll have legal draft a short amendment that inserts the invoice mapping language and the "Commitment Credit ID" clause. Once legal signs off we send to Dana to attach to the PO.

Approve me to proceed with the amendment and the single-line-month-1 credit handling. Ben — any pricing pushback?

Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Commercial Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Dana Morgan <dana.morgan@horizonlabs.com>
To: priyom.das@redwood.ai, vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@horizonlabs.com
Date: Mon, 30 Aug 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Redwood commercial - PO and invoicing constraints

Priyom / Vanessa,

Thanks for the quick turnaround and proposed mechanics — that works for us. We will: 

- Issue a single quarterly PO that references the amendment once you send it.
- Accept the Commitment Credit as a single negative line on the first monthly invoice (please ensure the invoice shows "Commitment Credit: CC-78391").
- Keep Net60 on the PO. We are not taking Net45 for this engagement.

I'll attach our signed PO as "Signed_PO_CC-78391.pdf" and you can attach the amended SOW for our records. Please send the SOW amendment with the invoice mapping language and credit wording and we'll finalize.

Appreciate it — Dana

Dana Morgan
Sr. Procurement Manager
Horizon Labs

Attachment: Signed_PO_CC-78391.pdf (application/pdf)
